title: Does MpesaQuick need root access to dial USSD directly?
question: In Figure 2 you showed the SIM dialog appearing automatically. Does Android allow apps to dial *334# directly without opening the phone dialer app, or does it require special permissions or root access?

reply.author: briomar
reply.content: No root required. It uses Android's native `ACTION_CALL` intent with encoded `#` URI fragments (`Uri.encode('#')`). This triggers the telephony modem directly, so it opens the carrier SIM prompt without ever touching or showing the phone dialer keypad. Standard `CALL_PHONE` permission is the only requirement.

title: Why not load the 24 SDKs in a background coroutine instead?
question: Why didn't the M-PESA team just initialize Dynatrace and Adjust inside Dispatchers.IO in Kotlin coroutines instead of blocking the main thread during startup?

reply.author: briomar
reply.content: Many enterprise SDKs (like Alipay/Griver and telemetry agents) require synchronous UI Context during Application `onCreate()`. Safaricom is using `androidx.startup.InitializationProvider` which executes synchronously before the first Activity even boots. Migrating them to asynchronous background workers requires refactoring their startup lifecycle.
